April 11

3 Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee. 4 Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength: (Isaiah 26:3-4 KJV)

You can see by this verse that to stay in the perfect peace of God, you have to keep your mind on the Lord. The only way to stay in the peace, that only God can give us, is to keep your mind at all times on the Word of God. Jesus said that you need to stay in the Word, so you will become a disciple indeed (John 8:31). One can contemplate the Word all day long, as you work, play, rest or whatever, and by doing so you will stay in perfect peace. Peter told us to speak the oracles of God (1 Peter 4:11).

The Hebrew word “YETSER” that was translated mind, means conception, and is referring to our imaginations. We can concentrate on God’s Word by using our imaginations. By thinking on the Word all day, you will come up with revelations that you can not get any other way.

Our spiritual strength comes from trusting and keeping our minds and imaginations on the things of God. It is impossible to live the Christian life unless you use the strength of the Lord. Our human strength is not up to living a godly life, so we must have the power of God that lives within us (Luke 10:19), to cope with the trials of this life. You need to use all the power of your born again spirit, to utilize the power of God that will allow you to live a life that is worthy of our being called a Christian (little Christ). If we are to do the works that Jesus commanded us to do (John 14:12), we will need the full power of God that dwells within us – Thank you Lord for sharing your power (Matthew 28:18) with us, your body.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
